geometric_order_source: CUT_OBJECT gate_passages[y].boundary_endpoint_order_top_to_bottom.west (frozen MWW cut slot order, slot 0 = top)
orientation_rule: west endpoint 'entry' = strand oriented into the cut tangle = tensor factor V (ground v_+, defect v_-); 'exit' = tensor factor V* (ground v_-^*, defect v_+^*)

oriented_model.algebra: U_q(sl2), Delta(E)=E(x)K+1(x)E, Delta(F)=F(x)1+K^-1(x)F, S(E)=-EK^-1, S(F)=-KF; dual action (x.f)(v)=f(S(x)v)
oriented_model.braiding: c = q^{-1/2} tau o q^{H(x)H/2}(1+(q-q^-1)E(x)F); every exponent integral on V, V*
oriented_model.coevaluation: u: coev_V : 1 -> V(x)V*, sum_i v_i (x) v_i^* (canonical)
oriented_model.evaluation: ell: ev'_V : V(x)V* -> 1, v_i (x) v_j^* -> sigma delta_ij q^{1*weight(v_i)} with sigma=-1
oriented_model.phi: phi: V* -> V, phi(v_-^*)=v_+, phi(v_+^*)=-q v_- (module map, verified)
oriented_model.sigma_note: sigma=-1 is the pivotal structure of the frozen public receipt (loop value -[2] at q=1, cap row e_87^*-e_2^*); sigma=+1 gives the standard loop value [2] and negates ell, hence negates the cubic

public_model.position_monomial: d_p = q^{1*p} (derived: unique monomial ratio conjugating the oriented V(x)V blocks to the Burau blocks)

public_order_source: B88_POSITION_TO_PASSAGE_TABLE.json index = 2*(wicket-1) + (0 negative copy, 1 positive copy); collar wicket order used by the cabled Artin word
thxy_order_rule: owner blocks (r_xy, m_2), wickets in decreasing word-letter order, copies (negative, positive) adjacent; reconstructed from the withdrawn -59072 and -2496 controls
transport_rule: x_public[p] = transport_monomial(p) * x_geometric[geometric_order(p)], transport_monomial(p) = d_p * pivotal(tensor factor at p)
